assets.label: barraca de tecidos e cerâmicas

assets.label: palmeiras e jardim desértico

Realistic volumetric foliage with cool lunar edges, subtle amber light from a tiny lantern at planter base. Not polygonal or toy-like. Full foliage and base visible. One isolated reusable vegetation cluster.
